svg.title: MOKS knowledge ingestion and retrieval
svg.desc: GitHub repositories, uploads and approved postmortems pass through secret exclusion, redaction and heading-aware chunking. Documents and chunks are committed to PostgreSQL, which is the authority. With an external index, an outbox event in the same transaction later writes OpenSearch or Pinecone, and embedding failure leaves the document keyword searchable. A kb_search or portal query becomes grants from the caller's role bindings. Keyword, exact identifier and optional vector rankers feed reciprocal rank fusion. Every candidate is rechecked against PostgreSQL, the pool widens up to 400 if too few survive, small signals rerank, duplicates collapse, and results carry citations, freshness and an evidence state of supported, weak or none.
